mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Harriet Park, and we are under a New Moon phase. Expect an overnight low of 37 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

Public Works has announced pavement repairs for November 10 and 11. Crews will be milling and patching various roads, including Nine Mound Road and Morningside Boulevard, so please keep an eye out for temporary parking restrictions from 7 AM to 7 PM.

It is a busy week for local fun. We have live music at Bailey's Run today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga tomorrow, or catch trivia and music at spots like Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's on November 11.

Looking at the weekly report, on October 25, Verona officers responded to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I after he was discovered stopped in the intersection.
Culver's is currently open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for the Flavor of the Day, which is Snickers Swirl.
